title: Creating a thrall
summary: Building a mortal bound by a demon’s pact.

claims.text: Thralls use the demon procedure with fewer points: Attributes 6/4/3 over one free dot each, and Abilities 11/7/4 with none above 3 at this stage.
They take 5 Background dots and 3 dots of Virtues over one free dot in each, a Faith potential of 1 and Torment 0.

title: Exposure
summary: A thrall’s past brushes with the supernatural.

claims.text: Exposure measures how much a thrall met the supernatural before the pact, from no contact at all through a fleeting accident to real study or even taking part in rituals.

When the Storyteller allows, the thrall may roll Wits + Exposure at difficulty 6 to draw on that past and understand what the pact is doing to them; a high Exposure does not by itself mean a high Faith potential.
